prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Edit this illustration with ONE targeted correction. Keep the same older adult, graphite clothes, neutral upright trunk, legs comfortably forward with heels on floor, camera and navy studio. No weights, no extra machine or chair, no muscle overlays, text or arrows. All body parts and towel remain fully visible. This is an example hold, not a certified technique demonstration.
